violation_type.title: Immunization Exception or Exemption on File and Verified (26 TAC §744.613(c))
violation_type.short_title: Immunization Exception or Exemption on File and Verified
violation_type.typical_finding: There were 11 children in care and the operation only had 5 children's records available for review and stated that they are waiting on immunizations from 6 children and did not have records avalaible for them.

finding_variants.text: There were 11 children in care and the operation only had 5 children's records available for review and stated that they are waiting on immunizations from 6 children and did not have records avalaible for them.
Documentation of an immunization exemption was not on file for 1 out of 10 children's files evaluated.
